_meta.role: quarry-equipped agent -- has the quarry CLI (/tmp/quarry-bench) and is instructed to prefer it over grep/read for symbol lookups, references, definitions, toc, and impact analysis

key_symbols.name: attachCmd
key_symbols.role: reads the operator's live terminal size via term.GetSize and calls Engine.AttachArgv before handing stdio to tmux

key_symbols.name: AttachArgv
key_symbols.role: builds the attach argv, chaining a client-sized select-layout when preconditions hold; degrades to bare attach on any failure

key_symbols.name: chainedAttachArgv
key_symbols.role: composes the bare attach-session argv with a ; select-layout command carrying the told-box layout string

key_symbols.name: liveBoxLocked
key_symbols.role: queries tmux's current live window size (display-message), falling back to configured Width/Height on failure

key_symbols.name: pinGeometryOptionsLocked
key_symbols.role: pins session options status=off and window-size=latest, the setting that makes tmux auto-track the attached client's size

key_symbols.name: readWindowSizeLatestLocked / readStatusRowsLocked
key_symbols.role: read back the effective pinned options to gate whether AttachArgv's chain is safe to build

key_symbols.name: planLayout
key_symbols.role: pure function mapping a strand table + box (told or live) to a tmux window_layout string and focus pane

key_symbols.name: applyLayoutLocked
key_symbols.role: fetches the fresh live box via liveBoxLocked and applies the recomputed layout via select-layout/select-pane

key_symbols.name: reconcileApplyPersistLocked
key_symbols.role: shared tail after every mutating op (add/remove/resume) that re-reads live panes/geometry and reapplies layout

key_symbols.name: ensureServerAndSessionLocked
key_symbols.role: boots tmux with new-session -x cfg.Width -y cfg.Height and calls pinGeometryOptionsLocked on fresh boot

summary: reed reads the operator's real terminal size only at attach time, in internal/reedcli/attach.go via golang.org/x/term.GetSize, and hands it as cols/rows into internal/reedengine's Engine.AttachArgv. While an operator is already attached and simply resizes their terminal window, reed does no polling of its own: tmux's window-size=latest option (pinned by pinGeometryOptionsLocked at boot and re-pinned defensively by AttachArgv) makes tmux itself continuously resize the live window to match the attached client, and reed only recomputes and reasserts its own precise row-budget layout the next time a mutating op runs, by querying tmux's live size fresh via liveBoxLocked/display-message in applyLayoutLocked. On a fresh attach or re-attach, reconciliation is explicit: AttachArgv deliberately ignores the live tmux size (which at that instant is still the stale, pre-attach value) in favor of the freshly told client size, per the documented Shared Decision 'told-box-wins-live-query-is-the-fallback', builds a layout string against that told box, and chains it onto the attach-session command itself so it lands after tmux's own attach-triggered resize has already taken effect, avoiding a double rescale. Every precondition check along this chain degrades to the bare, unchained attach on failure rather than ever blocking the handover.
